status: Completed R11 reproducibility and sampled-domain audit
interpretation: One local, seed-dependent, outcome-informed calibration; the two starts are nearby and are not robustness or global-optimality evidence.

pike_bosher.weighting: Baseline-relative EP error / (10 mV * sqrt(anchors per dose curve)).

asakuma.weighting: Resistance ratio error / 0.2; baseline-minus-nadir EP error / 10 mV.

rybak.weighting: EP and K group-mean reduction errors / reported SE; covariance unknown.

wang_1992.weighting: Baseline-relative EP error / (3 mV * sqrt(anchors per sound level)).

wang_1990.weighting: Separate-cohort EP difference error / (5 mV * sqrt(number of cohorts)).

salt_table_iii.weighting: Local-episode delta EP / (3 mV * sqrt(3 episodes)); no SD/n precision; timing window is hypothetical.

salt_figure_3.weighting: Each Figure 3 series uses baseline-relative errors divided by 3 mV or 3 mM times sqrt(points in that series); illustrative deterministic weights, not a likelihood. Fig. 3 is one paired EP/K animal.

residual_construction.pike_bosher: 12, 12, and 13 baseline-relative EP anchors for the 40, 60, and 80 mg/kg curves, respectively; each curve is divided by 10 mV * sqrt(anchors in that curve).
residual_construction.wang_1992: 15 baseline-relative EP anchors at each of 105, 115, and 125 dB SPL; each level is divided by 3 mV * sqrt(15).
residual_construction.salt_figure_3: 34 EP and 41 endolymph-K digitized anchors after omitting points within 0.4 min of stimulus switches; each series is baseline-relative and divided by its 3 mV or 3 mM scale times sqrt(series anchor count).
residual_construction.other_components: Asakuma uses two separate rounded endpoint contrasts (10 mV for EP reduction and 0.2 for resistance ratio); Rybak uses six separately minimized group-mean reduction contrasts scaled by their reported SEs, without EP/K covariance; Wang 1990 uses four separate cohort contrasts with an assumed 45 min delay and 5 mV * sqrt(4) scaling; Salt Table III uses nine rounded local-episode changes with 3 mV * sqrt(3) scaling and an assumed 1-3 min post-offset operator.

audit_sampling.calibration_scope: One recomputation of the stored residual vector at the selected parameter vector; 18 simulation_calls are calls to simulate, not optimizer iterations, objective evaluations, or all fit integrations.
audit_sampling.requested_output_times: Union of each simulation's original requested output times, all forcing boundaries, a 0.1-min grid, and the final requested time.
audit_sampling.state_sampling: States are the simulator outputs at requested t_eval times. Adaptive internal solver steps are not added to the reported extrema.
audit_sampling.per_protocol_indexing: Each intercepted simulation call is listed separately by analysis group, study, protocol label, simulation module, and deterministic call order. Solver variant, requested output spacing, time range, and start/midpoint/end forcing profile identify each protocol input. A flat CSV includes initial, final, minimum, and maximum values for each state and observable.
audit_sampling.equation_domain_checks: Every completed right-hand-side evaluation during the audited integrations completed without a logarithm/division domain error.
audit_sampling.limitations: Output-grid and right-hand-side checks do not prove continuous-time invariance or physiological admissibility.

domain_interpretation: Ranges summarize simulator outputs at requested times, including original finer outputs, forcing boundaries, and a 0.1-min audit grid; adaptive internal solver steps are not included in the extrema. The 18 calibration simulation calls comprise one recomputation of the fitted residual vector, not the optimizer's iterations or all fit integrations. Every completed right-hand-side evaluation passed the model's logarithm/division domain checks. This is not a continuous-time invariant proof; physiological screen crossings remain unpenalized. Tiny negative adaptation or trauma values within the model's 1e-8 validation tolerance are numerical output artifacts, not biologically meaningful negative states, and are reported rather than clipped.
